newsitem.title: UK: Racal up on news of strategic overhaul.
newsitem.headline: Racal up on news of strategic overhaul.

text.p: Shares in Racal Electronics Plc rose on Tuesday after the company announced it was poised to refocus on its three core business divisions telecommunications, data products and defence electronics.
By 0900 GMT Racal shares were up 1-1/2p to 235p.

"Refocusing on its strength should be a good sign", one trader said. "But we'll have to wait to hear what the company has to say," he added referring to a meeting of analysts with Racal's management this morning.
"The figures are in line with expectations but the outlook is a little bit worrying", another trader said.
Earlier the telecommunications to defence electronics company reported a drop in pretax profits from 70.4 million pounds to 40.4 million pounds for the year to March 31.
Racal also said it had called in mergers & acquisitions advisers to help to maximise the shareholder value.
